Maya: quick proposal 10min: single webinar with two sequential "labs" (startup then enterprise) + unified panel. keeps signup simple but lets us tailor demos. thoughts?
Priya: yes. we'll A/B abstracts and keep each <80 words. I'll draft two CTA variants and 2 hero images.
Jorge: registration needs a track field + "most important metric" (latency/cost/throughput/security) for SDR routing. add hidden UTM.
Leah: run-of-show suggestion:
00:00 welcome
05:00 startup lab (Rae) 10m demo
20:00 enterprise lab (Hamid) 10m demo
35:00 ops deep-dive (Jorge) 10m
45:00 panel + Q&A 20m
65:00 close/CTAs
Tom: rehearsal plan: tech check 3 days prior, dress 1 day prior. calendar-bot: "Tech check: 2026-04-05 09:00 UTC; Dress: 2026-04-07 15:00 UTC"
Priya: post-event kit: Colab + 5 starter prompts + checklist. that'll live in follow-up email.
Maya: fallback: pre-record demos + screenshot slides. Leah will call pivot if demo flops.
Rae: confirmed for startup lab, sending demo script tonight.
Hamid: confirmed enterprise, prepping compliance slide + fallback video.
Action items: Priya draft assets by Tue; Jorge build reg form + UTMs by Wed; Tom prepare pre-records + tech checklist by Wed; speakers confirm slides by EOD tomorrow; Leah drafts panel q's.
